messages:
James: FYI — escalated from acme-corp (Jane) — p95/p99 lines dropped from the latency dashboard after the config-rollout at 2026-03-16T22:13Z. They report normal request counts but tails are gone.

Maria: Can you paste the console link and screenshot? Any dashboard filters?

James: https://console.redwood.ai/dash/latency?env=prod&service=api
Screenshot uploaded to thread.
Filter used by customer: service=api ; env=prod

Ranjit: Noted. Did we roll any collector/transform around that time? I pushed a rollup change ~22:14.

Devon: I saw metrics-agg changed too — v2.5 rolled around 22:12. Possible tag rename or schema change.

ops-bot: deploy 2026-03-16T22:12:43 - metrics-agg v2.4.7 -> v2.5.0 by ranjit

Ranjit: Repro steps I tried: open prod latency dash, toggle percentiles overlay -> p95/p99 trace empty. Raw count/avg still present.

James: Customer is blocked on this view for their SLOs. ETA? Can we prioritize a short-term rollback or mapping fix? @Ranjit @Devon

Devon: Running quick raw query against backend to see which series are emitted.

Devon: Snippet of what I ran:
```
GET /metrics/query?expr=latency_seconds{service="api"}&agg=percentiles(95,99)&start=2026-03-16T22:00:00Z
# response: series list empty
```

Ranjit: I dug into the transform diff — we renamed the quantile tag key from `q` -> `quantile` in v2.5 to be explicit. Dashboard rendering code still looks for `q`. That mapping break would drop p95/p99 series from the UI.

Devon: I can push a compatibility layer to accept both tags (quick hotfix) and backfill series mapping. Preparing PR.

ops-bot: hotfix build started - metrics-agg v2.5.1 (patch)

Devon: Hotfix deployed to prod (canary -> 100%) at 2026-03-16T22:47:05. I see p95/p99 series returning in the raw query.

James: Customer confirms they're seeing the lines again. Thanks.

Jane (acme-corp): Confirmed — p95/p99 are back on my dashboard. Appreciate the quick turnaround! :tada:

Maria: Filing a postmortem and adding a test to coverage to detect tag-key mismatches on transforms.

Ranjit: Will follow up with a changelog note about the rename and the compatibility decision.

James: Closing the escalation.
